snippet.title: Palia | PS5 & Xbox - Elderwood Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Elderwood! Palia is about to get a whole lot bigger...and maybe a lil' spookier (but still cozy!) with the launch of the Elderwood Expansion, our most ambitious update so far!

🎮  Wishlist Palia now on PlayStation® 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010001
🕹️ Wishlist on Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/palia/9MTLHG50W87K!
🌳  Learn more about the Elderwood Expansion! https://palia.com/news/ps5-xbox-elderwood-announcement
🍄  Refer A Friend to earn exclusive rewards! https://palia.com/refer-a-friend
